dedupe_keys.name: australian national collection of homogenised observations of relative sea level anchors

description: ANCHORS is the Bureau of Meteorology collection of homogenised Australian tide-gauge observations and derived sea-level statistics. The current NCI record covers 38 gauges and describes records of at least 40 years, extending the article-era collection. CSV files are exposed through a public THREDDS catalogue under CC-BY-4.0 without a fee; NCI local computing access requires separate registration. Hourly adjusted and unadjusted observations support coastal flood and port-exposure simulations. Derived collections provide monthly and annual statistics, exceedance levels and flood-frequency projections to 2150. They complement regional coastal elevation and asset inventories. Homogenisation corrects non-geophysical shifts in annual means, but does not guarantee removal of all observational errors. Post-2019 observations are quality controlled and explicitly not homogenised. Future distributions depend on the selected sea-level scenario and should not be treated as observed events.
